taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-05 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 26.6 | 4.30 | 4.30
2 | 119.1 | 2.37 | 6.67
3 | 340.4 | 0.77 | 7.44
4 | 640.3 | 0.77 | 8.21
5 | 2441.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-05
Curve type: AA-type
Aquifer depth: 4.30–6.67 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive weathered zone (layer 2, ~119 ohm-m) between 4.30 m and 6.67 m depth for screening, as it represents the main water-bearing horizon in this basement sequence; case off the overlying low-resistivity topsoil and avoid deepening into the underlying high-resistivity fractured/fresh bedrock beyond ~7.4 m, which shows poor water yield potential.
